id.description: The kebab-case code used to identify this metric.

docs.description: All relevant information about this metric's documentation.

defaultConfig.description:
The set of configurations to apply to this metric if the current {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Config}
doesn't specify any configs for this metric.

additionalMeta.description:
Any information specific to a given metric but not covered by the other fields should
be stored here. This field is for internal use within the metric it applies to.

title:
This Type represents the metadata for a particular {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric}.
Any information about the metric that is unchanging (not configured) regardless of
the environment it's run in should be stored here. All metrics must have _exactly one_
instance of this Type.

@var CONFIG_TYPE
        The configuration Type associated with this metric. Can be either
        {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Config} or {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.Metric.Config}.

@see BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Config
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Meta
